item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
MacLeod rattles his cage in impotent fury.

My only problems, and I do mean only are the fact that it kind of clashes with how 343 is generally portrayed in the old stuff, and the meta title. Like, I can't see this entity as the same one depicted in tales or as a 'revised' SCP-343. The voices seem too different. And the meta title? I just… Idunno. If it worked both as a meta title and a regular title, I'd be fine with it.

However, this is absolutely excellent. I'd probably have downvoted if this were a 343 rewrite and I were a veteran because of my first problem, but as a tale, I can wholly support it and angrily wish this were a 343 rewrite with my problem addressed.
